# gyro_vpc (Data Source)

Looks up one private network (VPC) of Gyro Cloud Istanbul (tr-ist-1) by id or by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a VPC by name (or by id)
data "gyro_vpc" "uretim" {
  name = "uretim"
}

resource "gyro_server_nic" "worker" {
  server_id = gyro_server.worker.id
  subnet_id = data.gyro_vpc.uretim.default_subnet_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) VPC id. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) VPC name. Set id or name.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String)
- `default_subnet_id` (String) Id of the subnet created with the VPC.
- `gateway_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the VPC gateway (NAT, hourly prepaid billing) is on.
- `gateway_nat` (Boolean)
- `gateway_public_ip` (String)
- `gateway_status` (String) off, active or syncing.
- `inter_subnet` (String) allow or deny.
- `project_id` (Number)
- `region` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `subnets` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:
